completeCard.name: Druidic
completeCard.effect: Know Druidic. Other speakers notice and read your hidden Druidic messages. Nonspeakers notice their presence on WIS Perception DC 15 but need translation magic or learning the language to read them.

source.originalText:
Druidic
You know Druidic, the secret language of druids. You can speak the language and use it to leave hidden messages. You and others who know this language automatically spot such a message. Others spot the message's presence with a successful DC 15 Wisdom (Perception) check but can't decipher it without magic.

completeCard.name: Spellcasting
completeCard.effect: Prepare and cast according to the engine. WIS attack/DC; rank gates, components, concentration, Dissonance and RP apply. This entry creates no extra actions or second resource pool.

source.originalText:
Spellcasting
Drawing on the essence of nature itself, you can cast spells to shape that essence to your will. See chapter 10 for the general rules of spellcasting and chapter 11 for the druid spell list.
Cantrips
At 1st level, you know two cantrips of your choice from the druid spell list. You learn additional druid cantrips of your choice at higher levels, as shown in the Cantrips Known column of the Druid table.
Preparing and Casting Spells
The Druid table shows how many Resonance Points you have to cast your druid spells. A spell's base RP cost is twice its Resonance Rank (Rank 0 cantrips cost 0), modified by explicit class features and current Dissonance. You regain expended RP according to the Resonance recovery rules.
You prepare the list of druid spells that are available for you to cast, choosing from the druid spell list. When you do so, choose a number of druid spells equal to your Wisdom modifier + your druid level (minimum of one spell). The spells must be of a level for which you have Resonance Points.
For example, if you are a 3rd-level druid, you have 7 Resonance Points. With a Wisdom of 16, your list of prepared spells can include six spells, and they can be of 1st or 2nd level in any combination. If you prepare the Rank 1 spell cure wounds, its base cost is 2 Resonance Points before explicit specialization or Dissonance modifiers. Casting the spell doesn't remove it from your list of prepared spells.
You can change your list of prepared spells when you finish a long rest. Preparing a new list of druid spells requires time spent in prayer and meditation: at least 1 minute per spell level for each spell on your list.
Spellcasting Ability
Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for your druid spells, since your magic draws upon your devotion and attunement to nature. You use your Wisdom whenever a spell refers to your spellcasting ability. In addition, you use your Wisdom modifier when setting the saving throw DC for a druid spell you cast and when making an attack roll with one.
Spell save DC = 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Wisdom modifier
Spell attack modifier = your proficiency bonus + your Wisdom modifier
Ritual Casting
You can cast a druid spell as a ritual if that spell has the ritual tag and you have the spell prepared.

Spellcasting Focus
You can use a druidic focus as a spellcasting focus for your druid spells.

completeCard.name: Shapeshifting
completeCard.effect: Assume an unlocked prepared form or revert early. Apply engine HP, equipment, concentration and reserve rules. This is not a spell and cannot copy monster stat blocks.

source.originalText:
Shapeshifting
At 1st level, you gain the ability to transform into various animal forms. Shapeshifting is Aethel's native druidic transformation discipline and functions according to the following rules:

Activation and Duration
You can use a bonus action to assume a beast form. You can remain in beast form for 10 minutes per use. You then revert to your normal form unless you expend another use of this feature. You can revert to your normal form earlier by using a bonus action on your turn.

Uses per Day
At 1st level, you can use your Shapeshifting ability twice per long rest. You gain additional uses as you reach higher levels, as shown in the Shapeshifting Uses column of the Druid table.

Available Forms
At 1st level, you can transform into any of the Base Druid Forms listed below. At 11th level, you gain access to Arch Druid Forms. At 10th level, you gain access to Hero Druid Forms specific to your chosen Circle.
Limitations While Transformed
While in beast form:
You cannot cast spells unless specified by your Hero Class
Your ability to speak is limited (only preserved in arch/hero forms)
You retain your mental ability scores (Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma)
You gain the physical traits of the chosen form as specified

completeCard.name: Arcane Bolt
completeCard.effect: Arcane Bolt. Tags: base, active, wizard-spell, universal, damage. Make a Wizard spell attack. On a hit deal S d6 + M force damage. Arcane Bolt is an always-prepared class matrix once acquired and uses the normal first-distinct-matrix and Refrain rules.

source.originalText: Arcane Bolt: Launch a bolt of pure arcane energy that deals force damage to a single target.

completeCard.name: Arcane Shield
completeCard.duration: Until start of your next regular turn
completeCard.effect: Arcane Shield. Tags: base, active, wizard-spell, abjuration, protection. Trigger when an attack roll would hit you. Gain +2 AC against the triggering attack and until the start of your next regular turn, potentially causing the attack to miss. Temporary AC from another Arcane Shield does not stack.

source.originalText: Arcane Shield: Create a barrier of magical force that provides temporary protection.

completeCard.name: Arcane Insight
completeCard.effect: Arcane Insight. Tags: base, passive, knowledge. Gain proficiency in Arcana, or expertise if already proficient. When examining an active magical effect, spell residue, magic item or arcane construction, you may make an Intelligence (Arcana) check to determine its broad school, function or unusual matrix behavior. The Director sets the normal knowledge DC; failure supplies no invented fact.

source.originalText: Arcane Insight: Identify magical effects and items with greater accuracy than non-wizards.

completeCard.name: Spell Scribing
completeCard.effect: Spell Scribing. Tags: base, passive, spellbook. Copying a legal found Wizard spell into your spellbook requires 1 hour and 25 gp of inks and components per spell rank, treating rank 0 as rank 1 for this calculation, instead of the pilot baseline 2 hours and 50 gp. Level-up spells remain free.

source.originalText: Spell Scribing: Copy spells into your spellbook at half the normal cost and time.

completeCard.name: Spellbook Study
completeCard.effect: Spellbook Study. Tags: base, active, matrix, ritual. Replace one currently prepared matrix with one legal spell recorded in your spellbook. The replacement must be within your Wizard rank limit. This is the normal midday substitution permission; it does not alter the spellbook, create another prepared-matrix position or reset first-cast/Refrain history for an underlying matrix family already cast this encounter.

source.originalText: Spellbook Study: Spend time studying your spellbook to prepare a different selection of spells.

completeCard.name: Scholarly Mind
completeCard.effect: Scholarly Mind. Tags: base, passive, knowledge. You have advantage on Intelligence checks whose primary purpose is recalling, researching or analyzing arcane theory, magical history, planar magical principles or constructed spell formulae. It does not grant advantage on spell attacks, Counterspell checks or general Investigation unrelated to arcane scholarship.

source.originalText: Scholarly Mind: Gain advantage on Intelligence checks related to arcane knowledge.

completeCard.name: Arcane Sight
completeCard.effect: Arcane Sight. Tags: arch, active, wizard-spell, divination, concentration. While active you perceive magical auras within 60 feet and automatically know each visible aura's school or broad magical category. As an Action on a later turn, examine one aura to learn whether it is concentrated, summoned, cursed, warded or linked to another visible magical effect. Total cover blocks sight.

source.originalText: Arcane Sight: See magical auras and effects for a short duration.

completeCard.name: Sigil Rewrite
completeCard.effect: Sigil Rewrite. Tags: arch, passive-upgrade, matrix. Replace one prepared matrix with a different spell from your spellbook of exactly the same rank without performing the normal 10-minute ritual. The replacement receives no special Dissonance reset for a matrix family already used this encounter and must obey current Wizard rank eligibility.

source.originalText: Sigil Rewrite: Once/day, instantly swap a spell you know for another of the same tier

completeCard.name: Matrix Efficiency
completeCard.effect: Matrix Efficiency. Tags: base, passive, matrix. Your normal full daily Spell Matrix preparation time is reduced from 1 hour to 45 minutes. This does not reduce the separate 10-minute midday substitution ritual, spell scribing, rituals or spellbook reconstruction unless another feature explicitly says so.

source.originalText: Matrix Efficiency: Reduce the preparation time for spells by 25%.

completeCard.name: Matrix Mastery
completeCard.effect: Matrix Mastery. Tags: arch, passive, matrix. During preparation you may assign at most one common Matrix Mastery modification to each ordinary prepared spell: Quick Substitution, Component Enhancement, Matrix Linking or Stability Reinforcement, using the exact common definitions in the Wizard engine. Always-prepared class-card matrices cannot receive these modifications unless a card explicitly says otherwise.

source.originalText: Matrix Mastery: Modify spell matrices to change minor aspects of prepared spells.

completeCard.name: Floating Preparation
completeCard.effect: Floating Preparation. Tags: arch, passive, matrix. Increase your maximum prepared Spell Matrix count by 1. The extra matrix can come from any school and obeys all ordinary spellbook and rank restrictions. It is a prepared matrix for every rule, including protected strain, duplicate-family tracking and Matrix Mastery modifications.

source.originalText: Floating Preparation: Prepare 1 extra spell from any school each day

completeCard.name: Spell Tether
completeCard.effect: Spell Tether. Tags: arch, passive-upgrade, concentration, tether. When you begin a second concentration spell that targets only yourself while already concentrating on a self-only spell, spend 3 additional RP. For up to 3 rounds you may maintain both. Whenever damage requires a concentration save, make one save; failure ends BOTH spells. Starting a third concentration effect ends both tethered spells before the new one begins. Spell Tether and Tethered Cast cannot be combined; maximum two sustained concentration effects total. Only one Spell Tether can exist at a time.

source.originalText: Spell Tether: Maintain 2 self-buff spells without concentration (1/rest)

completeCard.name: Improved Concentration
completeCard.effect: Improved Concentration. Tags: arch, passive, concentration. You have advantage on Constitution saving throws made because damage threatens your concentration on a Wizard spell. This does not alter the DC, protect a Tether from rules that explicitly end both effects, or prevent Silence, incapacitation and other non-damage concentration failures.

source.originalText: Improved Concentration: Advantage on concentration checks when taking damage.

completeCard.name: Dispel Magic
completeCard.rangeAndTarget: One creature, object or magical effect within 60 feet
completeCard.effect: Dispel Magic. Tags: arch, active, wizard-spell, abjuration. Choose one ongoing spell effect you can perceive. If its rank is 3 or lower, end it. If it is rank 4 or higher, make an Intelligence check adding proficiency against DC 10 + spell rank; success ends it. Permanent artifact properties and effects explicitly immune to dispelling are unaffected.

source.originalText: Dispel Magic: End magical effects in an area or on a target.

completeCard.name: Spell Preservation
completeCard.effect: Spell Preservation. Tags: hero, spellbinder, passive, spellbook. Your primary spellbook cannot be destroyed, erased or rendered permanently unreadable by non-artifact mundane or magical means. It can still be stolen, hidden, transported, suppressed, sealed by an artifact-level effect or voluntarily abandoned. Copies and backup books do not automatically receive this protection.

source.originalText: Spell Preservation: Your spellbook cannot be destroyed by non-artifact means.

completeCard.name: Seal Magic
completeCard.effect: Seal Magic. Tags: hero, spellbinder, wizard-spell, control. Choose one of the eight schools and target one creature. It makes a Wisdom save. On failure it cannot cast spells of the chosen school. At the end of each of its turns it repeats the save, ending the Seal on success. The effect ends automatically after 3 rounds and never prevents non-spell class techniques merely because they are magical.

source.originalText: Seal Magic: Prevent a target from casting spells of a specific school (WIS save, 3 rounds)

completeCard.name: Arcane Lock
completeCard.rangeAndTarget: One door, chest, portal or unattended object within touch
completeCard.effect: Arcane Lock. Tags: arch, active, wizard-spell, abjuration. Magically seal the target. Opening it without your permission requires a Strength check or thieves'/arcane-tool check against your Wizard spell DC. Dispel Magic can end the lock. You can designate up to M creatures who can bypass it. This does not make the object physically indestructible.

source.originalText: Arcane Lock: Create a magical barrier that prevents entry or access to an object or area.

completeCard.name: Knowledge Shield
completeCard.rangeAndTarget: Allies directly protected by one of your Abjuration Wizard spells
completeCard.duration: Until start of your next regular turn
completeCard.frequency: At most once per ally per round
completeCard.effect: Knowledge Shield. Tags: hero, spellbinder, passive, protection. When you cast an Abjuration spell that grants AC, temporary HP, resistance or a saving-throw benefit to an ally, that ally also gains +2 on its next saving throw before the start of your next regular turn. Multiple Knowledge Shields do not stack.

source.originalText: Knowledge Shield: When you cast a protective spell, allies gain +2 to saving throws.

completeCard.name: Dimensional Pocket
completeCard.effect: Dimensional Pocket. Tags: arch, active, wizard-spell, conjuration, ritual. Create an extradimensional storage space holding up to 100 pounds or 10 cubic feet of unattended nonliving material. Retrieving or placing an item while adjacent to the opening uses an object interaction. Living creatures cannot enter. When duration ends, remaining contents appear harmlessly in the nearest unoccupied space.

source.originalText: Dimensional Pocket: Create a small extradimensional space to store items.

source.originalText: Arcane Tradition: Choose a school of magic to specialize in, gaining bonuses to spells of that school.

source.originalText: Counterspell: Disrupt an enemy's spellcasting, potentially negating their spell entirely.

automaticCards.cost: Pay the Core V 2 RP cost for one rank above the spell's normal cast rank
